game_concept: A tower defense set in Snowy Hold – Ice Market, a market under icicles: the snow ranger must handle blizzard sprites while practicing functions. Core idea – Boolean Guards: Write functions returning True or False that guard checkpoints.
theme: Snowy Hold – Ice Market: a market under icicles
core_gameplay_loop: In Ice Market, repeat each round: Write functions returning True or False that guard checkpoints. Each round, blizzard sprites strike the hold gate, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the guards value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Protect the hold gate from blizzard sprites in Ice Market: keep the guards meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 80-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: guards drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 80-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 10 (extended tier): Boolean Guards
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how guards changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against blizzard sprites in Ice Market.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 80 seconds while guards > 0.
